facts.text: DDX_Text binds control1013(0x3f5) to UI+1484 and1014(0x3f6) to UI+1488. The helper calls GetWindowTextLengthA/GetWindowTextA into CString<char> on save/validate.

DDV_MaxChars is called with16 for both char strings and compares stored char-buffer length. Empty-value messages identify username and password. The already verified submit chain passes these byte buffers unchanged to request10; no hash/case/trim conversion was identified in this bounded path.

Fixed dialog133 resource has23 controls. Controls1013/1014 are Edit;1014 has password display style. Neither declares uppercase/lowercase/OEM/numeric conversion style. This is initial resource configuration, not all runtime behavior or a code-page observation.

The callback has16 stack arguments (RET0x40), and the zero-result consumer10 (RET0x28). Pseudocode omits the final argument; tailWordB is actually forwarded and used in the remaining-points sprintf at413651.

On wordB0, empty byteList enters the no-profile/registration-offer branch. Otherwise the UI copies byteField to its opaque buffer, pairwise sorts byteList with W1..W4, preserves row pairing, uses W2 for a billing branch,W3 through localtime,W4 for expiry branch,and W1 for state. It displays tailWordB via signed decimal formatting and adjusts tailWordA by0x80000000 for a later opaque scalar.

Selection reads a signed16-bit state stored from W1 and permits0/-4; it also rejects W2!=0 AND W4!=0. The native UI ignores W1..W4 counts after parsing and could truncate state. Independent projection requires column coverage and canonical signed16 encoding.

Zero callback path clears its wait UI/timer, increments wizard stage, closes the channel and then projects choices. Nonzero callback goes through the failure UI reset and closes the channel without the same stage advance. The independent projection performs no UI/channel/launch side effects.
